comment: Findings recorded here are excluded from the release image scan gate. Every entry must bind the exact finding it covers - image, package, installed version, and vulnerability id - match the digest-pinned base image the image is actually built from, carry a reason, and stay inside its review_by date; an expired exemption, a new CVE on the same package, or a base image change fails the gate again. Everything else with an available fix at High or Critical still fails CI.

exemptions.reason: Re-reviewed 2026-10-22; cross-channel false positive: https://linux.oracle.com/errata/ELSA-2026-50075.html uses epoch 10 for FIPS packages. Ordinary BaseOS https://linux.oracle.com/errata/ELSA-2026-1473.html fixes the same 12 CVEs in 1:3.5.1-7.0.1.el9_7; installed non-FIPS 1:3.5.8-2.0.1.el9_8 includes those fixes and https://linux.oracle.com/errata/ELSA-2026-77396.html. Vendor CVE lists and the installed RPM changelog reviewed. Native AMD64/ARM64 scans at main 12ed7b4bccd34f6558b48232705226254bc1b26d still report this exact finding: https://github.com/GentleKingson/ocservia/actions/runs/39777404600 (Grype 0.119.0; DB built 2026-10-22T06:29:52Z). The full gate fails on separate ELSA-2026-500448 findings; those are not covered here. Review deadline is unchanged; other advisories remain gated.

Reviewed 2026-10-22 cross-channel false positive: https://linux.oracle.com/errata/ELSA-2026-500448.html covers CVE-2026-84782 in FIPS packages with epoch 10 (10:3.5.8-2.0.1.el9_8_fips). Ordinary BaseOS https://linux.oracle.com/errata/ELSA-2026-77396.html fixes the same CVE in the installed non-FIPS 1:3.5.8-2.0.1.el9_8. Vendor CVE lists and the installed RPM changelog confirm the fix; native AMD64/ARM64 scans in https://github.com/GentleKingson/ocservia/actions/runs/39777404600 confirm this exact finding and installed version on both architectures. This entry covers only this advisory and exact package version/base image. Re-review by 2026-10-26 against then-current vendor records and installed packages; no automatic renewal. Other advisories remain gated.
